content:
Webb reached its fully deployed configuration in its second week. Routine science began six months after launch.

To fit inside the Ariane 5 fairing, the telescope had to launch folded. Unfolding involved more than 50 major steps and over 300 possible single points of failure. At Webb’s distance from Earth, repair was not possible.

The deployment proceeded smoothly, but reaching its final configuration was just one stage. The telescope and instruments cooled for several weeks. Mirror alignment followed in months two through four, then instrument-mode calibration in months five and six.

Webb’s second-week milestone completed deployment. The months of commissioning that followed brought it to the start of routine science operations.
